limits: No GPU/provider/holdout access or host-scanning test cleanup; tests retain exact own real handles.
Role supervision has no controller-wide ACK, persistent controller membership, adoption, or v2 crash recovery.
A role-local result does not verify research correctness or roll back permitted prior file/provider effects.
Current receipt and closure guards do not sandbox same-UID adversarial mutation.
Legacy v1 role paths remain; supervised branches do not use nonce/PGID discovery as closure proof. Existing stall progress diagnostics may still read /proc.
No native AttemptRef or new database was introduced; existing trigger records are operational authorization, not scientific observations.
Own helper/process review is author review; independent review covers root and Pro changes only.
No whole Core/Pro test run is claimed here.
